notes.title: Reflection: The Greed I v1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear [b]Reflection: The Greed[/b] Players,

Below is a summary of what we fixed in this update:
- Death screen issue when jumping from the balcony fixed,
- Some collision bugs fixed,
- Fixed the issue of falling under the map at various points (especially on the 2nd Floor),
- Some sound levels have been changed and brought to appropriate levels.


Please let us know the problems you encounter so that we, as the developer team, can take action as quickly as possible and optimize your game experience. We recommend you all to update the game to the latest version (v1.1.2) and look forward to your feedback as always.
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/Avymwu3Mhr/

[b]Mail:[/b] info@zonexstudio.com


Thank you very much for your continuous feedback and we wish you pleasant games!

Regards.
- Reflection Developer team

notes.title: Reflection: The Greed I v1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Dear [b]Reflection: The Greed[/b] players,

We would like to inform you about the update for [b]Reflection: The Greed[/b]. Here are the patch notes for this update:

[h3][b][Developer's Note: Before making this update, if you have any Save Files, you must delete them or press the 'New Game' button. Otherwise, your game may crash when you click 'Continue'.
You can delete your game's Save Data from: 'Appdata > Local > Reflection' (Delete the Reflection folder.)][/b][/h3]

[b]Optimization issues improved[/b]
Finally, optimization issues have also been improved. In this way, the game will run faster and players will be able to play the game more fluently.


[b]Save system improved[/b]
The save system has been improved. The infrastructure of the Save system has completely changed.


[b]Artificial intelligence improved[/b]
Artificial intelligence has been improved. Various bugs such as falling under the map while escaping from the AI have been eliminated.


[b]Speed balanced[/b]
The walking speed of the character and the AI has been increased. Stamina will now degrade more slowly. Now you can run longer.


[b]Fixed the issue where certain animations were not playing for some players[/b]
Fixed a bug for players who had problems with some animations not being able to play. Now players will be able to see all animations without any problems.


[b]Visual Quality improved[/b]
Visual quality has been improved, players will now see a better quality environment.


[b]Fixed certain Texture bugs[/b]
Fixed some Texture bugs. In this way, players will have a better visual experience in-game.


[b]Lighting updated[/b]
Lighting has been updated. Improved lighting at various locations on the map.


[b]Fixed audio glitches[/b]
Fixed audio glitches. Now players will be able to hear all in-game sounds more clearly.


[b]Fixed game crashes after Quicktime Event for some players[/b]
It has been detected that some players in your game are experiencing crashes after Quicktime Event, and this problem has been fixed.


[b]Fixed post cutscene crashes for some players[/b]
It has been determined that some players have crashed the game after cutscenes, and this problem has also been fixed.


[b]Interactive objects made more prominent[/b]
Interactive objects have been made more prominent. It will now be more obvious when you zoom in on interactive objects.


[b]Environmental factors increased[/b]
Environmental factors were multiplied. There are now many more interactive objects on the map.


[b]Inventory System has been updated[/b]
The inventory system has been updated and is now more useful. Now the items you collect can stack on top of each other and you can see the names and descriptions of the items. In this way, players will be able to manage the items in their inventory more easily.


[b]Information screen has been updated[/b]
The information screen has been updated. Now players will be informed more easily.


[b]GUI designs have been updated[/b]
Updated GUI designs. In this way, players will have a better gaming experience.


Thanks to all these updates, our game has become more fluid, more informative, better designed and running faster. We hope these updates will positively impact players' gaming experience. We recommend you all to update the game to the latest version (v1.1.1) and look forward to your feedback as always. Stay tuned for new updates and innovations!


[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/Avymwu3Mhr/

[b]Mail:[/b] info@zonexstudio.com

Thank you very much for your continuous feedback and we wish you pleasant games!

Regards.
[b]- Reflection Developer team[/b]

notes.title: Reflection: The Greed | v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear [b]Reflection: The Greed[/b] Players,

We have just released a hotfix update to address some of the issues you may have encountered since the launch of our game, Reflection. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we're committed to providing the best gaming experience possible.
We'll get into list of changes, but before that we wanted to let you know that's just the beginning of patches that will be released soon.

Here's a brief overview of the improvements that included in this hotfix:

- Fixed a critical bug causing occasional [b]game crashes[/b].
- Resolved an issue with save files not loading correctly.
- Adjusted audio levels for a better sound experience.
- Fixed minor [b]texture and graphical glitches[/b].
- Fixed some [b]localization errors[/b].


We encourage you to update your game to the latest version (v1.0.1) to enjoy these enhancements. As always, if you encounter any issues or have further feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team.
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/Avymwu3Mhr/

[b]Mail:[/b] info@zonexstudio.com


Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

Best regards,
The Reflection Development Team
